name: Brex
description: Connect Brex to Claude for automating your company's finances. Finance monitors compliance and runs powerful queries. Employees get personalized memo guidance, policy answers, and status updates. Permission-based access ensures admin oversight while streamlining management.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.brex.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brex MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brex provides these MCP tools: get_card_by_id, get_expense_policy, get_reimbursement_payout_date, get_user_by_id, get_user_myself, list_my_cards, list_my_expenses, list_my_limits, list_users, and list_users_by_name_or_email.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brex?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brex in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Brex requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brex is developed by Brex. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
